## Introducción: Modelo de Black-Scholes

- Valora opciones europeas bajo suposiciones ideales.
- Fórmula para una **call** europea:

\[
C = S_0 N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2)
\]

\[
d_1 = \frac{\ln(S_0 / K) + (r + \frac{\sigma^2}{2})T}{\sigma \sqrt{T}}, \quad
d_2 = d_1 - \sigma \sqrt{T}
\]

---

## Introducción: Árbol Binomial

- Aproxima el precio de una opción en pasos discretos.
- Cada paso: el activo sube (\(u\)) o baja (\(d\)).
- Probabilidad neutra al riesgo:

\[
p = \frac{e^{r \Delta t} - d}{u - d}
\]

- Cálculo hacia atrás desde el vencimiento; converge a Black-Scholes.

---

## Función Black-Scholes

```{r}
black_scholes <- function(S, K, r, T, sigma, type = "call") {  
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r + 0.5 * sigma^2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  if (type == "call") {
    price <- S * pnorm(d1) - K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(d2)
  } else {
    price <- K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(-d2) - S * pnorm(-d1)
  }
  return(price)
}
```

---

## Función de Árbol Binomial

```{r}
binomial_option_price <- function(S, K, r, T, sigma, steps, type = "call") {
  dt <- T / steps
  u <- exp(sigma * sqrt(dt))
  d <- 1 / u
  p <- (exp(r * dt) - d) / (u - d)
  asset_prices <- numeric(steps + 1)
  option_values <- numeric(steps + 1)
  for (i in 0:steps) {
    asset_prices[i + 1] <- S * u^i * d^(steps - i)
  }
  if (type == "call") {
    option_values <- pmax(asset_prices - K, 0)
  } else {
    option_values <- pmax(K - asset_prices, 0)
  }
  for (j in (steps - 1):0) {
    for (i in 0:j) {
      option_values[i + 1] <- exp(-r * dt) * (p * option_values[i + 2] + (1 - p) * option_values[i + 1])
    }
  }
  return(option_values[1])
}
```

---

## Ejemplo (Call)

```{r}
S <- 100; K <- 100; r <- 0.05; T <- 1; sigma <- 0.2; type <- "call"
steps_seq <- 1:100
binomial_prices <- sapply(steps_seq, function(n) binomial_option_price(S, K, r, T, sigma, n, type))
bs_price <- black_scholes(S, K, r, T, sigma, type)
```

---

## Gráfica de Convergencia (Call)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(steps_seq, binomial_prices)
ggplot(df, aes(x = steps_seq, y = binomial_prices)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bs_price, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Convergencia del Árbol Binomial al Precio de Black-Scholes", x = "Número de pasos", y = "Precio") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Ejemplo (Put)

```{r}
S <- 80; K <- 80; r <- 0.03; T <- 1; sigma <- 0.10; type <- "put"
steps_seq <- 1:100
binomial_prices <- sapply(steps_seq, function(n) binomial_option_price(S, K, r, T, sigma, n, type))
bs_price <- black_scholes(S, K, r, T, sigma, type)
df <- data.frame(steps_seq, binomial_prices)
```

---

## Gráfica de Convergencia (Put)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(df, aes(x = steps_seq, y = binomial_prices)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bs_price, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Convergencia del Árbol Binomial al Precio de Black-Scholes (Put)", x = "Número de pasos", y = "Precio") +
  theme_minimal()
```
